description: Add a later ADMIN_BALANCE-funded milestone to a canonical-admin-org OpenTrain contract: the milestone ends ACTIVE_FUNDED with internal-balance funding metadata. Zero money moves and no approval record is created; the milestone approval/release that moves money stays human-only in the web app. Same fail-closed authorization as opentrain_create_admin_balance_hire (default-off surface; the scope alone never grants access). Domain sequencing applies: an earlier unreleased milestone conflicts until a human approves/releases it. Request-bound idempotency: same idempotencyKey + payload converges on the same milestone; key reuse with a changed payload conflicts.

contractId.description: OpenTrain contract id to add the ADMIN_BALANCE-funded milestone to.

idempotencyKey.description: Request-bound idempotency key (1-128 chars of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, colon). The same key with the same payload converges on the original result; reusing a key with a changed payload conflicts.

volume.description: Positive hours/labels for PAY_PER_HOUR or PAY_PER_LABEL. Omit to derive from amountUsd and the canonical contract rate.

name: opentrain_create_admin_balance_milestone
